data: Do all three progressions, arithmetic, geometric, and harmonic, achieve the same minimum?

The caption states that the distributions of popularity scores calculated by arithmetic, geometric, and harmonic progressions are shown on the same datasets. The graph shows three lines representing these progressions, with the y-axis ranging from 0 to 70. The lines for all three progressions converge at approximately the same point on the x-axis, which corresponds to a value of around 5 on the y-axis. This indicates that all three progressions achieve the same minimum value. Therefore, the answer is yes, all three progressions achieve the same minimum.
